AUTHOR: Lawal
TITLE: MADNet: Marine Animal Detection Network using the YOLO platform
REGION: Brackish: Limfjord, northern Denmark; UOv2 (URPC2019): China; RUOD: mixed/unspecified
SPECIES: Marine animals; fish only as generic classes ('fish', 'small fish' in Brackish; 'fish' in RUOD) alongside crab, jellyfish, shrimp, starfish, echinus, holothurian, scallop, corals, diver, cuttlefish, turtle, waterweeds
DATA: Public datasets: Brackish (Roboflow-processed, 14,674 images), UOv2/URPC2019 (Roboflow100, 7,600 images), RUOD (14,000 train/val + 300 test images)
V_EV: Underwater datasets (RUOD): 'diverse environmental challenges such as haze-like effect, color cast, and light interference'; Brackish camera 'mounted 9 meters below the surface'
D2: Brackish 8:1:1 (11739/1467/1468); UOv2 7:2:1 (5320/1520/760); RUOD 9800 train / 4200 valid + 300 provided test images
D_EV: Underwater datasets: 'The dataset with 14674 images ... was randomly divided into train-set, valid-set, and test-set in an 8:1:1 ratio'
R_EV: Tables 4-7 report each dataset trained and tested separately: 'The trained algorithms were evaluated on valid-set and test-set' of the same dataset
C_EV: no statement found (training 'with ... other default settings'; no confidence threshold value or false-positive verification reported)
E_EV: Eq. (11): 'The n is the number of images, while Gi and Pi, respectively, represent the ground-truth count and predicted count for the i-th image.'
ARCH: MADNet (YOLOv5/YOLOv8-based with C3b, SPPFr, C3; anchor-based and anchor-free variants) vs YOLOv5n, YOLOv6n, YOLOv7-tiny, YOLOv8n
METR: P, R, mAP50, params, FLOPs, training time, fps, count MAE
NOTE: General marine-animal detector; fish are among the classes in Brackish and RUOD but no fish-specific results are reported (UOv2 has no fish class). INCL=Y, consistent with S032 (Brackish dataset paper). D: the authors re-split Roboflow-processed Brackish randomly 8:1:1 (not the original predefined frame-based split), and UOv2 was randomly split by Roboflow100, so D1 = image-level random. RUOD test = 300 images (100 each blur/color/light), but results are reported only in aggregate, so V6=N. Trained from scratch (PRE=없음). E: per-image count MAE against ground-truth annotation counts of the same images (all classes pooled), so 사람 계수와 비교 / same-footage reference, E_ALL=P. MAE is computed on the combined valid+test sets. NCLASS varies by dataset (6/5/10), left null. NIMG = 14,674 + 7,600 + 14,300. The datasets link is on figshare; code is in S1 File.
